name: National Archaeological Museum
description: One of the great collections of ancient Roman art, with mosaics, frescoes and objects found at Pompeii and Herculaneum.

name: Stadio Diego Armando Maradona
description: SSC Napoli’s home stadium in the Fuorigrotta district, renamed after Diego Maradona in 2020.

name: Vele di Scampia
description: Huge sail-shaped public housing blocks from the 1960s and 70s in the northern suburb of Scampia, partly demolished since the 1990s.

name: Pompeii
description: The Roman town buried by Vesuvius in AD 79, south of Naples. Porta Marina is the main gate into its excavated streets and houses.

name: Piazza del Mercato
description: A large square near the port that was for centuries the city’s main market and its place of public executions.

name: Pio Monte della Misericordia
description: A small 17th-century church run by a charity, with Caravaggio’s Seven Works of Mercy above the altar.

name: Pizzeria Brandi
description: An old pizzeria near Piazza del Plebiscito that claims the margherita pizza was first made here, in 1889.

name: Mount Vesuvius
description: The volcano that buried Pompeii in AD 79 and last erupted in 1944. A path leads up to the rim of the crater.

name: Castel Nuovo
description: A medieval castle by the port with five round towers and a white marble triumphal arch at the entrance. It houses the civic museum.
